This is Tom, in London. He writes reassuring pamphlets for the government. At ten, the internet went down.
By noon, France had mobilised. Tom was asked to make the pamphlets more reassuring.
At one, the sirens. Tom went underground, with the pamphlets.
At ten past two, France detonated a nuclear weapon over the Celtic Sea, as a warning.
Underground, an emergency meeting was scheduled to schedule the emergency meeting.
On day two, a ceasefire. Both sides argued about the table.
On day three, Tom came home. The pamphlets were finally ready.
